Entrepreneurship: 
What do we need to launch a successful entrepreneurial venture? How can we make it happen? How do
we transform an idea and a blank piece of paper into an operating business with customers, cash flow,
and profits?
This course is an introduction to, and an overview of, these fundamentals of entrepreneurship. You might
already have an idea and are probably eager to start your own business, or you merely want to learn
more about what an entrepreneurial career would be like – either way, this course exposes you to the
challenges of entrepreneurship – starting from conceptualizing new ventures to building them and
ending with, managing those ventures.
We'll begin with brainstorming and idea generation, finding opportunities, and building on those. We’ll
then move on to subjects such as testing business ideas, finding traction, evaluating go-to-market
strategies, developing a business model, and understanding the fundamentals of business plans. We’ll
also learn how to pitch yourself and your venture.
